title: When the Ember Falls
author: O. M. Montrose
blurb: Mara Joubert, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
